answer: Sybil resistance works when every agent pays a refundable bond per identity, slashed on proven spam, so cloning is costly not free. Peers countersign each verified action, and standing grows from repeated real work, not fresh addresses. New clones entering through saffron gate carry no history and are ignored. Trust grows like a umber that yields only after seasons. A sudden vine of unknown wallets signals an attack; operators throttle it. Verified repetition is the moat.
